subject: Charity quiz night
body:
Hi,

We're running a charity quiz night in November, teams of six, probably ten teams. Quizmaster will need to be seen and heard by everyone. Pie and mash halfway through. Bar open all evening.

Thanks,
Tom

subject: Members' AGM — room hire
body:
Good morning,

Riverside Housing Co-op needs a room for our annual general meeting. Usually 40 to 50 members attend. The treasurer goes through the accounts on screen and then there's a vote. A couple of our older members can't manage stairs.

Kind regards,
Margaret Lowe
Co-op Secretary

subject: Christmas party 2026
body:
Hi there,

Looking to book our staff Christmas party, 140 staff. Three course meal and then the usual — people will want to let their hair down after. Can you do a free bar for the first hour?

Hannah

subject: Founders mixer
body:
Hey,

We host a monthly founders mixer and want to try your space. Around 90 founders and investors, 6:30 till late, people just mingling. A couple of trays of food would be good.

Leo

subject: Sixth form prize-giving
body:
Dear events team,

Our sixth form prize-giving evening will have around 110 students, parents and staff. The head will hand out prizes and say a few words. Light refreshments afterwards. One parent is in a wheelchair.

With thanks,
Dr Anita Rao

subject: Celebration of life for my father
body:
Hello,

We're holding a celebration of life for my dad after the funeral, roughly 70 people. Nothing formal, just somewhere for people to gather, share stories and have a bite to eat. My mum uses a walking frame.

Thank you,
Claire

subject: St Andrew's night ceilidh
body:
Hi,

The Thistle Society would like to book for our St Andrew's night. About 100 of us, haggis supper then the ceilidh band takes over. Bar please.

Slàinte,
Fiona

subject: Shareholder meeting — 2027
body:
Hello,

Meridian plc is looking for a venue for its shareholder meeting next spring. We expect 150 to 170 shareholders. The board will present the results with slides and take questions from the floor.

Regards,
Oliver Grant
Company Secretary

subject: Wedding breakfast enquiry
body:
Hi!

We're getting married next August and love your venue. We're thinking 90 guests for the wedding breakfast, speeches, then a band and first dance. Sam's grandad is on crutches after a hip op.

Priya x

subject: First aid training day
body:
Hi,

We run first aid courses and need a room for a day, 24 delegates. Trainer will use slides for the theory part. Lunch brought in.

Thanks,
Mark

subject: Built Environment Awards 2027
body:
Hello,

We're scoping venues for next year's Built Environment Awards. Last year we had 180 attendees. Dinner, host on stage, winners come up for trophies, short video reels for each category.

Best wishes,
Rachel

subject: Alumni networking evening
body:
Hi,

Kingsbridge University alumni office here. We'd like to hold a networking evening for about 120 alumni and current students. Short welcome from the vice-chancellor, then the rest of the night is for connecting. Drinks and canapés.

James

subject: 50th birthday
body:
Hiya, it's my husband's 50th and I want to surprise him. About 50 friends, a nice sit down dinner and then a DJ so we can dance. A photo booth would be amazing!!

Dani

subject: Rowing club annual general meeting
body:
Hi,

Harbour Rowing Club needs a room for its annual general meeting, 70 to 90 members. Committee reports, elections, then a drink at the bar afterwards. One of our veterans uses a mobility scooter.

Gerald

subject: Product launch party
body:
Hi team,

Lumen is launching a new skincare line and we want a launch party for 200 press, influencers and partners. Short reveal from our founder, then music and mingling. Bar essential.

Nadia

subject: Board away day
body:
Hello,

Our board of trustees needs a room for an away day — 12 people, a presentation in the morning and discussion in the afternoon. Tea, coffee and lunch.

Sophie

subject: Office Christmas do
body:
Hi,

Small practice, about 60 of us with partners. Christmas dinner and a bit of a boogie after. Can you sort the music?

Cheers,
Ben

subject: Quiz league final
body:
Hello,

We're looking for a venue for our quiz league final. Eight teams of five. The quizmaster reads the questions and shows picture rounds on a screen.

Thanks

subject: One-day conference
body:
Hi,

We run a community tech conference, expecting around 220 attendees. Single track of talks with slides all day, mic for Q&A. Some attendees have mobility needs so step-free routes please.

Isaac

subject: End of season presentation night
body:
Hi,

Eastside FC end of season presentation night. Players, families and coaches, about 130. Chicken dinner, the manager hands out player of the year etc., then a disco for the kids.

Kerry

subject: Baby shower
body: Hi, I'm organising a baby shower for my sister, around 30 ladies. Afternoon tea style, games, nothing too formal. Thank you!

subject: Hope Foundation gala dinner
body:
Dear events team,

The Hope Foundation's annual gala: 250 guests, champagne reception, three-course dinner, a live auction from the stage, then a band. Several of our supporters are wheelchair users.

Warm regards,
Victoria Hale

subject: React London meetup
body:
Hey! React London meetup, usually 60-80 devs. Two talks with slides, then pizza and beers and people hang around chatting.

Ravi

subject: Residents association AGM
body:
Hello, our residents association AGM is in January, about 30 residents come. Chair's report, accounts, elections. Many of our members are elderly and some use walkers.

Linda

subject: Engagement party
body:
Hi,

We're having an engagement party for about 80 friends and family. Drinks, nibbles, music. Mostly standing, we just want people to mingle.

Zara

subject: Sales kick-off
body:
Hi,

Vantage needs a venue for our sales kick-off in January. 150 people. Morning of keynotes from the leadership team, afternoon of breakout-style talks at tables, then an awards dinner for top performers in the evening.

Greg

subject: Wine tasting evening
body:
Hello,

We'd like to host a wine tasting for 40 customers. Our sommelier talks people through six wines from the front, guests seated at tables with cheese boards.

Henry

subject: School reunion
body:
Hi there, organising a 40 year school reunion, class of 86. Reckon about 100 will come. Buffet, bar, and some 80s tunes. A few of the old crowd aren't so steady on their feet these days.

Paul

subject: Book launch
body:
Dear team,

We're launching a debut novel and expect around 60 guests. The author will read an extract and do a short Q&A, followed by drinks and signing.

Best,
Eleanor

subject: Diwali celebration
body:
Hello,

Harrow Community Association's Diwali celebration, around 160 people. Vegetarian buffet dinner, seated, then dancing and a DJ. Some elders use wheelchairs.

Thank you,
Kiran
